people.name: John
people.line: The Baptist, a prophet who prepared the way for Jesus

translations.web: Then John’s disciples came to him, saying, “Why do we and the Pharisees fast often, but your disciples don’t fast?”
translations.bsb: Then John’s disciples came to Jesus and asked, “Why is it that we and the Pharisees fast so often, but Your disciples do not fast?”
translations.kjv: Then came to him the disciples of John, saying, Why do we and the Pharisees fast oft, but thy disciples fast not?
translations.asv: Then come to him the disciples of John, saying, Why do we and the Pharisees fast oft, but thy disciples fast not?
